pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Divine Gold Ingots are a collab material from $(l:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/goety-revelation)Goety Revelation$()$(li)Melt Divine Gold Ingots into $(bold)Molten Divine Gold$(), then cast Divine Gold parts (or use the ingot directly as the material item)$(li)It is a $(bold)T4$() material (netherite mining level) and requires the Goety Revelation add-on to obtain$(br2)Note: this material is hidden from the Creative inventory when the Goety/Revelation add-on is not installed.

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(bold)Soul Mending$()$(default): spend soul energy to restore durability$(li)$(bold)Laevatain$()$(melee): true-damage pierce + heal-block + max-health cut$(li)$(bold)Divine Power$()$(melee): imbue magic containers with a mana aura$(li)$(bold)Gungnir$()$(ranged): projectiles inflict Stun/Burn Hex on hit$(li)$(bold)Returning$()$(ranged): arrows return to the wielder$(li)$(bold)Godrealm Overstep$()$(armor): immune to fire/explosion/magic damage$(li)$(bold)Heaven & Earth Forged$()$(armor): cap incoming damage$(li)$(bold)Soul Discount$()$(armor): reduced soul cost when casting$(br2)Divine Gold is a top-tier all-round collab material covering melee, ranged and armor.
